title: La Comida --- A Noun You Can Build
label: ch:noun-comida
canDo: I can build comida from comer with -ida, and know that nouns made this way are feminine.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C43-comida: derive comida from comer and say what gender the -ida ending guarantees.
payoff.note: The ending matters more than the word: it is the first noun the reader could have produced without being told, and it carries its gender with it.
